negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak and English for a standalone, browsable NBS register of fit-and-proper approvals / approved key function holders (e.g. 'zoznam udelených predchádzajúcich súhlasov', 'zoznam vedúcich zamestnancov'). No such dedicated register surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Individual prior-consent approvals appear to be published only as operative parts of decisions inside the general 'výroky rozhodnutí' register and its PDF archives, not as a structured person-level dataset.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The A5 pipeline cannot rely on a clean person-role table from NBS; it must NER-extract names and roles from decision text, which raises extraction cost and error rate.

negative_findings.description: A search-result snippet referenced a codelist endpoint under https://subjekty.nbs.sk/api/ for PSD2 institution-type codes, and the subjekty.nbs.sk page advertises 'Databáza na stiahnutie'. I did not independently confirm the endpoint shape or that a full entity export exists.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bulk/API access is plausible but unconfirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If a real API exists it removes the need for brittle scraping of the flagship pointer source; confirming it is the highest-leverage next engineering step.

negative_findings.description: Could not confirm from the fetched subjekty.nbs.sk content whether the supervised-entity records include statutory-body member names, or only entity identity and scope of authorisation.
negative_findings.result_summary: The fetch returned navigation/sector structure only; person-level fields were not visible.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines whether NBS's register alone can answer 'who holds which seat', or whether ORSR/Obchodný vestník must carry that load.

negative_findings.description: The page requiring supervised entities to inform NBS about general meetings and sessions of the supervisory board and statutory body was found under the insurance (poistovníctvo) branch. A banking/payments equivalent was not located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Mechanism confirmed for insurance; unconfirmed for banks and payment institutions.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If a banking analogue exists, it is a near-real-time governance-event channel; if not, the cell must fall back on decisions + commercial register.

negative_findings.description: English searches found ECB fit-and-proper methodology and aggregate sanctioning statistics, but no ECB publication naming individuals approved to Slovak bank boards.
negative_findings.result_summary: ECB fit-and-proper outcomes for Slovak significant institutions appear not to be published at person level.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For ECB-supervised Slovak banks, the regulator gatekeeper thesis holds legally but yields no public name-level record; NBS decisions, ORSR and Obchodný vestník become the operative sources.

negative_findings.description: ORSR's own public search does not support full-text search by predmet podnikania or by SK NACE code. Fetching https://www.orsr.sk/search_subjekt.asp showed the available criteria to be: obchodné meno, právna forma, registrový súd, and — via separate pages — IČO, sídlo, spisová značka, and priezvisko/meno osoby. There is no activity-code filter.
negative_findings.result_summary: The cell hypothesis that ORSR itself can enumerate the SK financial/payments population by NACE is not supported; that capability sits in the ŠÚ SR RPO register/API instead, which carries SK NACE.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Population enumeration must be built as RPO(SK NACE) -> IČO list -> ORSR per-entity monitoring, or via the NBS supervised-entity lists, not by querying ORSR directly. Designing the collector the other way round would silently miss most actors.

negative_findings.description: No official ORSR-side push feed (RSS/webhook/'recently changed entries' listing) for statutory-body changes was found in either Slovak or English searching.
negative_findings.result_summary: Change detection appears to require either periodic diffing of per-entity extracts, ingestion of the Obchodný vestník, or a commercial aggregator (FinStat) / civic aggregator (Slovensko.Digital) that does the diffing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection cost and latency for this cell are driven by polling design; budget for diff-based monitoring rather than assuming a subscribe-able feed. Unverified whether the new sluzby.orsr.sk portal exposes such an endpoint.

negative_findings.description: Re-use and rate-limit terms were not verified first-hand for orsr.sk, registeruz.sk and obchodnyvestnik.justice.gov.sk (no robots.txt or ToS fetched in this pass). Slovensko.Digital's rate limit and FinStat's paid tiers are known only from their own marketing/service pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Access/legal_status values for the state portals are stated from statutory context, not from a fetched policy document.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Before production scraping, robots.txt and terms for each state portal should be read, and the Slovensko.Digital podmienky-sluzieb reviewed, to avoid building a collector on unverified permission.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovak register-side vocabulary exists for 'hiring' or 'jobs' below board level — registers record only štatutárny orgán, prokúra, dozorná rada, vedúci organizačnej zložky and (via RÚZ annual reports) priemerný počet zamestnancov.
negative_findings.result_summary: This cell can evidence leadership moves and headcount aggregates, but not recruitment or mid-level hiring.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Jobs/hiring topics in this run must be carried by other A5 cells (job boards, LinkedIn-type sources, press); registers should not be over-claimed as a hiring signal.

negative_findings.description: Klub 500 (owners of companies with 500+ employees) does not publish a member list; reporting indicates members prefer not to be named publicly.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched sk-language for 'Klub 500 členovia zoznam'; found only the organisation profile, LinkedIn page and commentary, no roster.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Klub 500 was named in the cell scope as a directory candidate; it is a lobbying voice but NOT usable as an actor directory. Track its statements, not its membership.

negative_findings.description: AmCham Slovakia's published committee list (15 committees/working groups) does not include a dedicated Financial Services committee.
negative_findings.result_summary: Committee names found: Civil Code Task Force, Business-Academic Cooperation, Digital, Employment and Social Affairs, Energy, Health Care, Public Procurement Task Force, Rule of Law Initiative, Tax. No financial-services committee surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The seed query assumed such a committee exists; A5 should instead use the Digital and Employment & Social Affairs committees plus the board (which includes Citibank) as the finance-relevant entry points.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovak 'asociácia platobných inštitúcií' (association of payment institutions) was found as a distinct body.
negative_findings.result_summary: sk-language searches returned the Slovenská FinTech asociácia, SBA and insurance/intermediary bodies instead. The payment-institution segment appears represented via the FinTech association and SBA's payments commissions rather than a standalone association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents chasing a non-existent directory; the NBS register of payment institutions (a different cell) plus slovakfintech.sk/clenovia are the substitute enumeration.

negative_findings.description: SBA's ~14 expert commissions are described in aggregate (200+ professionals) but individual commission member rosters are not published on the public site.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both the sk seed query on pracovné skupiny and a fetch of /o-nas/ returned commission names only, no named members.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The richest named-officeholder layer in this cell is not directly harvestable; must be reconstructed indirectly from standards documents, SEPA implementation plans, and conference agendas.

negative_findings.description: The most detailed AOCP and ITAS leadership rosters found via search are from earlier terms, not confirmed current.
negative_findings.result_summary: AOCP výbor names (Blaho, Franek, Kopál, Laluha, Prekop, Vrzgula, Zelina) and ITAS 2017 board (Fitoš, Lelovský, Chamraz et al.) come from dated announcements.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Do not treat these as current officeholders; the value is the pattern (announcement page type recurs each term), not the specific names.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'Kongres Slovenskej bankovej asociacie' (SBA banking congress) event page, programme or speaker roster could be located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searching 'kongres Slovenskej bankovej asociacie program recnici' in Slovak returned only the SBA corporate site, its Wikipedia entry, SBA Educa (exam body) and directory listings — no congress page. SBA may not run a public named congress, or it is announced only via LinkedIn/members-only channels.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief assumes a flagship SBA congress as a primary org-chart snapshot; if it does not exist publicly, Finweek and ZBK events must carry that role.

negative_findings.description: No Slovakia-hosted 'Banking Summit' was found; the term maps to foreign events.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bilingual search for 'banking summit' / 'bankovy summit' Slovensko 2026 returned only Future Banking Summit (Brasov, RO, 7-9 Oct 2026), European Banking Summit (28 Jan 2026), FT Global Banking Summit and vendor listicles. No SK-hosted equivalent surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: 'Banking Summit' is a noisy term for SK scouting; regional CEE summits (Brasov) should instead be mined for Slovak speakers rather than treated as SK sources.

negative_findings.description: No CEE/Central-Europe edition of the ICCOS cash-cycle seminar exists for 2026.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only EMEA (Cape Town, 30 Nov - 2 Dec 2026) and Americas editions are scheduled; ATMIA covers Europe via a Berlin/Madrid roadshow. No CEE-specific cash/ATM conference with a published SK speaker roster was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cash-cycle and ATM function holders in SK banks have no regional conference stage, so this function will stay under-observed by the events channel and needs a different source (tenders, vendor case studies).

negative_findings.description: ZBK events page publishes no speaker names on the listing page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetch of zbk.sk/podujatia returned five 2026 events with title/date/venue (Crowne Plaza Bratislava) but no lecturers, titles or agendas at listing level. Speaker data, if published, sits on per-event detail pages or PDF programmes not reachable from the listing excerpt.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must follow event detail pages and PDFs, not just the calendar, or the highest-value cards/payments name-title data will be missed.

negative_findings.description: No university career-fair exhibitor list for EUBA or STU Bratislava could be located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovak search for 'Den kariery Ekonomicka univerzita Bratislava STU vystavovatelia banky 2026' returned only university profile pages, catalogues and Wikipedia — no career-day page with an exhibitor roster. Such pages likely exist on faculty subdomains or Facebook events not indexed by the search engine used.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: University fairs are the cell's stated signal for graduate-pipeline expansion by banks; without exhibitor lists this sub-channel is currently unsourced.

negative_findings.description: The two richest people-level event sources are gated.
negative_findings.result_summary: LinkedIn (association pages, event attendee/speaker lists) is auth-walled with anti-scraping ToS; The Banker's Bank of the Year coverage is subscription-only. Both were reachable only through open mirrors (bank press releases, TASR/OTS).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated collection must route around them via press-release mirrors and manual analyst review, or title data will be incomplete and legally risky to gather.

negative_findings.description: The ÚVO root domain https://www.uvo.gov.sk/ surfaced in search results with an 'Error' page title, and section URLs were reachable only indirectly via search snippets during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as unverified, not dead. ÚVO is a statutory portal and is near-certainly live; the symptom is consistent with bot-defence, transient outage or a redirect. Liveness must be settled by the deterministic verification pass, and an open-data / TED fallback route is already listed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Declaring the primary SK procurement portal dead on one bad signal would break the whole public-portal route for this cell.

negative_findings.description: Searched for a central SK registry of political/board nominations to state-owned enterprises (the 'nominacie.gov.sk' hypothesis) that would consolidate appointments to SZRB, Eximbanka and similar.
negative_findings.result_summary: No such consolidated nominations register was found. Civil-service vacancies are centralised at cisss.gov.sk, but board appointments to state-owned banks are decided by the vláda SR and surface only in government session records, MF SR press releases, the institutions' own pages and news wires.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership-move tracking for state-linked banks cannot be single-sourced; it needs a multi-source watch (institution page + MF SR + wire) rather than one register poll.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak for a current contractual/ownership nexus between Slovenská pošta and Poštová banka covering cash operations at post-office counters.
negative_findings.result_summary: Found Poštová banka's own cash-operations product page and Slovenská pošta's procurement profile, plus a CRZ listing for Slovenská pošta, but no specific published contract between the two was located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The post-office cash network is a major SK payments channel; the contractual arrangement must be located in CRZ full text rather than assumed, and remains an open collection task.

negative_findings.description: TED could not be queried with a live SK+CPV filter through generic web search; only TED's own help, CPV and sector-browse pages were retrievable.
negative_findings.result_summary: No actual SK payment-services notice was retrieved in this pass. The TED entry is recorded as a high-confidence structural source (official API/bulk data documented), not as a set of verified individual notices.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The candidate must be operationalised with real API queries before anyone assumes SK payment-services notices exist in volume on TED.

negative_findings.description: Leadership facts retrieved via search snippets carry uncertain dates (e.g. an SZRB board-change item that appears to date from 2012; Eximbanka items spanning 2022-2023).
negative_findings.result_summary: No leadership roster is recorded here as current. Only the source pages are recorded; the roster itself must be read fresh from the institution's own page at collection time.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A5 conclusions built on undated snippet-level leadership claims would be wrong; this is precisely why the primary governance pages are ranked above the news wires.

negative_findings.description: No Accenture Slovensko-specific announcement of a financial-services lead or SK FS practice leadership change was surfaced by either sk- or en-language searching.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for 'Accenture Slovensko novy riaditel financial services' returned only PwC/other results; no Accenture SK newsroom item located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Accenture is a named cell actor; without a locatable SK newsroom, its FS leadership moves may only be observable via LinkedIn or third-party media, which changes the collection method.

negative_findings.description: No Finastra press release or reference page naming a Slovak bank customer was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Temenos/Finastra + Slovakia searches produced only a partner-licensing item (Orion Innovation) and generic vendor pages; no SK-named Finastra deployment.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leaves a gap in mapping which global core/payments vendors actually serve SK systemic banks; supplier-side visibility for Finastra in SK appears near-zero.

negative_findings.description: Slovak banks deliberately do not name their IT suppliers, as noted in SK trade coverage curated by Asseco itself.
negative_findings.result_summary: A clipping titled to the effect that banks do not boast about their IT suppliers and present digital innovation as their own work; several vendor references are anonymised ('a financial institution').
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale and means client attribution must often be inferred from job ads, LinkedIn and anonymised case-study detail rather than stated client names.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'banking delivery centre' designation or banking-specific headcount breakdown was found for Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions Slovakia.
negative_findings.result_summary: Company pages give total headcount (>3,900) and a general ICT-outsourcing mission for DT Group clients, not a banking vertical figure.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Supplier headcount for this actor cannot be attributed to bank spend; it is a labour-market benchmark only, not a bank-programme signal.

negative_findings.description: No SK-specific IBM Slovensko or DXC Technology Slovakia customer/reference page for banking was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned only directory and country-profile mentions; no vendor-hosted SK banking reference pages surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two named cell actors remain unmapped; their SK bank footprint may only be visible via job ads or global case studies filtered by country.

negative_findings.description: No public, per-employer register of collective-redundancy notifications (hromadné prepúšťanie) filed with ÚPSVaR was found. Searches surfaced only procedural guidance and aggregate counts; the notification itself contains employee names/addresses and is evidently not published.
negative_findings.result_summary: Aggregate statistics and press releases exist; a named, case-level feed does not appear to be public.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most valuable A5 signal (which bank, how many, when) is likely obtainable only via aggregate data plus press/union corroboration, or via an infozákon (211/2000) freedom-of-information request to ÚPSVaR.

negative_findings.description: No European Works Council or zamestnanecká rada page was found for the Slovak subsidiaries of Erste (Slovenská sporiteľňa) or Intesa Sanpaolo (VÚB). Searches in both sk and en returned only ownership/corporate background.
negative_findings.result_summary: Works-council-level disclosure for SK banks appears absent from the open web.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: EWC consultation documents often describe cross-border reorganisations first; without them the workforce channel depends on national unions and press.

negative_findings.description: No company-level collective agreement (podniková kolektívna zmluva) text for any Slovak bank was located publicly; only the higher-level (KZVS) deposit register is public, and banking currently has no sector agreement because SBA refuses sector bargaining.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank-level CBA texts not publicly posted.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Redundancy severance multiples and consultation terms — the concrete cost of restructuring — stay invisible; must be inferred from union statements.

negative_findings.description: Obchodný vestník, Register úpadcov (JSF/xhtml) and NR SR document viewer are ASPX/JSF applications with parameterised URLs; their machine-accessibility (stable IDs, bulk export, robots policy) was not tested in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs recorded; liveness and scrapability left to the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are the backbone automation targets for this cell; if they resist crawling, budget for browser automation.

negative_findings.description: Targeted Slovak-language searches for a banking or payments shared-service/GBS centre in Žilina or Banská Bystrica returned no sector-specific hits; results were generic municipal-employment and job-portal pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query 'Žilina Banská Bystrica centrum zdieľaných služieb banka poisťovňa nové pracovné miesta 2025' produced no relevant financial-sector centre announcements.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Either these cities host no significant banking/payments nearshore delivery footprint, or such presence is announced only through channels not reachable by generic search (employer career sites, local print press). Coverage for the western/central regional cities is therefore thin and should not be read as absence.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of a Worldline, Global Payments, Mastercard or Visa delivery/operations centre located in Košice, Nitra or Prešov.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payments-scheme and acquirer searches surfaced only global corporate and careers pages, no Slovak regional-city site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The payments half of the sector may be Bratislava-concentrated in Slovakia, with the regional nearshore footprint dominated by IT/finance captives of banks and telcos instead. Needs confirmation against company registry data rather than search.

negative_findings.description: No concrete bank–university partnership or bank-sponsored graduate programme in eastern/central Slovakia was located via search, in either language.
negative_findings.result_summary: TUKE searches confirmed a Finance/Banking/Investment study programme but surfaced no named bank partnership, scholarship or trainee scheme.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The university-industry angle of the cell is currently evidenced only structurally (via Košice IT Valley membership), not by specific programmes; requires direct fetching of faculty partner pages and career-fair exhibitor lists rather than search engines.

negative_findings.description: The only banking-specific Košice expansion article surfaced (HSBC expands to Košice, The Slovak Spectator) is roughly a decade and a half old.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned the item but its vintage makes it unusable as current intelligence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Search-engine ranking favours old, well-linked articles for this cell; collection must be recency-filtered and driven by feeds rather than ad-hoc search.

negative_findings.description: Tatra banka's press-release index at https://www.tatrabanka.sk/sk/blog/tlacove-spravy/ returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain server-side fetch, while individual article slugs on the same path are indexed and reachable via search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as bot-defended-but-live, NOT dead. Requires a browser-like fetch (real UA, JS-capable client) or an RSS/sitemap route.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Tatra banka is one of the three systemic SK banks; losing its self-published leadership channel would leave a hole that only third-party wires could partially fill.

negative_findings.description: No standalone Slovak-language press centre was located on mbank.sk itself; the SK press function appears to live on the group subdomain sk.media.mbank.pl. Likewise no distinct SK press/'o nás – vedenie' subpath was confirmed for oberbank.sk within this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: mBank SK press room identified on a foreign-group host; Oberbank SK press/management subpath unresolved (only the site root confirmed).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Branch-form banks (pobočka zahraničnej banky) often have no SK-level governance page at all, so SK branch leadership must be inferred from group announcements plus the SK company register — a systematically weaker signal for the smaller players in the cell.

negative_findings.description: Slovak-language searches for Prima banka press releases on predstavenstvo/dozorná rada changes returned almost only annual-report PDFs and third-party portals, not a press-release index on primabanka.sk.
negative_findings.result_summary: No press-release feed confirmed for Prima banka; the manazment-banky page plus annual reports plus orsr.sk are the practical channel.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For this actor, page-diffing and register-diffing must substitute for press monitoring, which changes the collection design and the achievable detection latency (months, not days).

negative_findings.description: Prima banka annual reports are served from /preview-file/<slug>-<numeric-id>.pdf paths where the numeric id appears to be a rotating internal document id.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hard-coded PDF URLs are likely to break between years.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector that pins these URLs will silently start failing; the link must be re-resolved from the site each cycle.

negative_findings.description: FinStat.sk, the most convenient aggregator of SK register + financial + headcount data, is a commercial service with paywalled tiers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded with collection_allowed=false; usable as a manual entity-resolution pointer or under a paid API licence only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids building a pipeline on a source whose ToS would not survive review, when orsr.sk provides the same statutory facts for free.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Erste Group 'Capital Markets Day' event page or deck focused on a Slovakia segment restructuring or a Bratislava hub relocation was found in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned only regular quarterly results presentations and earnings calls in which Slovakia is discussed as one of seven core markets; no CMD-specific Slovak restructuring material surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumes CMD decks are a leading indicator; for Erste the practical substitute is the quarterly results deck plus the annual report segment chapter, so collection design should not depend on a CMD cadence.

negative_findings.description: No Intesa Sanpaolo price-sensitive release specifically announcing a current VUB Banka management change was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: The IR press-release archive surfaced results releases and historical Slovak items (2002 IntesaBci-in-VUB anniversary, 2004 pension JV) plus a newsroom CEO interview, but no recent VUB board-change ad-hoc.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Suggests Intesa treats VUB executive appointments as non-price-sensitive and routes them to the newsroom or to VUB itself, so the Slovak-language cell may lead the English parent cell for this owner — the opposite of the cell's default assumption.

negative_findings.description: There is no Slovak-domiciled UniCredit issuer with its own IR channel.
negative_findings.result_summary: UniCredit's Slovak business has operated since Dec 2013 as a foreign-bank branch (pobocka zahranicnej banky) of UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia, so disclosure sits at unicreditbank.cz and unicreditgroup.eu.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collector keyed to a Slovak UniCredit IR domain will find nothing; the branch structure must be encoded in the actor map or UniCredit SK leadership changes will be missed entirely.

negative_findings.description: OTP has no Slovak banking subsidiary.
negative_findings.result_summary: OTP Banka Slovensko was sold to KBC (agreed 17 Feb 2020, closed 27 Nov 2020) and merged into CSOB; OTP Group IR is therefore historical for SK.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The seed actor list includes OTP; keeping it at normal priority would waste collection budget. Demote to low-frequency watch.

negative_findings.description: No PPF Group ownership link to a Slovak bank or licensed payment institution was confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searching the parent-owner set surfaced J&T Finance Group as the relevant Czech-domiciled owner (365.bank, J&T Banka SK branch); PPF did not appear as an owner of an SK bank in any result reviewed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: PPF appears in the cell brief paired with J&T; treating them as equivalent would create a phantom actor. PPF should be re-tested specifically against payments/consumer-finance entities rather than banks before being kept or dropped.

negative_findings.description: Slovak-language search returns almost no parent-group ad-hoc material.
negative_findings.result_summary: The sk query using 'ad hoc oznamenie / materska skupina / zmena predstavenstva / generalny riaditel' returned Slovak media and subsidiary newsrooms (slsp.sk, vub.sk, banky.sk, startitup.sk), not parent-group regulated disclosure.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's English-first design is correct and that it does not overlap the sk newsroom cell; but it also means sk terms are useful only for entity-name joins, not for finding parent disclosure.

negative_findings.description: The OeKB Issuer Information Center was not fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Its role as Austria's OAM feeding the Wiener Boerse ad-hoc page was established indirectly from search results; the portal itself and its search/export interface were not exercised.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: It is likely the highest-integrity archive for Erste/RBI regulated news; access mechanics (search UI vs. API, rate limits) must be tested before it can be designed into a collector.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovak-language trade outlet or newsletter covering the payments-processing/acquiring industry as an industry (people moves, hub news) was found; SK payments coverage is scattered across general finance media (Finsider, Trend, HN) and PR wires.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for SK payments-sector trade press returned only consumer-facing card/bank stories and job boards.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: There is no single high-yield SK feed for A5-type events; collection must be assembled from registers plus employer sites plus general media, raising cost and latency.

negative_findings.description: No SK-specific corporate presence or Slovak legal entity for NCR Atleos surfaced in search; only the US-listed parent appeared. Its SK footprint (if any) may sit under a Czech or Hungarian entity, or under an outsourced service partner.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query pairing Diebold Nixdorf with NCR Atleos in Bratislava returned Diebold Nixdorf s.r.o. records only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One named actor in the cell may have no direct SK employer footprint; ATM-estate signals for NCR may have to be tracked via bank tenders and service partners instead.

negative_findings.description: No Visa or Mastercard country-manager-for-Slovakia appointment announcement was found in either sk or en searching; scheme coverage appears to be run from a Prague/CEE cluster with SK folded into CZ&SK roles.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovak query 'Visa Mastercard country manager Slovensko vymenovanie' returned card-portfolio news and a Prague-based CZ&SK Mastercard vacancy, no appointment news.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's assumption of discrete SK country managers at the schemes may be partly wrong; monitoring should target CZ/CEE cluster announcements and Workday postings rather than SK-only news.

negative_findings.description: No Wirecard-successor entity with a live Slovak operation was identified in this pass; no SK-language term for such successors surfaced beyond generic 'platobná inštitúcia'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Not evidenced in searches performed; the actor was not pursued to exhaustion.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A named actor group in the cell brief may be irrelevant to SK, or requires a different entity-name entry point (e.g. via NBS PSD2 register diffing rather than by brand name).

negative_findings.description: It is unconfirmed whether ÚPSVaR proactively publishes a list of received mass-layoff notifications, or whether such lists are obtainable only by FOI request.
negative_findings.result_summary: The ÚPSVaR page describes employer obligations but no public notification register was located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The highest-value layoff early-warning channel may be FOI-gated, which changes collection design (periodic infožiadosť rather than scraping).

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn — the richest source for country-manager and hub-lead moves — is auth-walled and its ToS prohibits automated collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: Company pages surfaced in search but content is login-gated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A core A5 signal channel cannot be automated; budget for manual analyst review or a licensed people-data provider.

negative_findings.description: No Slovak equivalent of a 'people moves' / appointments column was found for the fintech small-cap segment. Searches in sk for leadership changes at named actors (Fumbi, Finax, TrustPay/finby) returned company profile pages and review articles, not personnel news.
negative_findings.result_summary: Leadership-move intelligence for this cell has no single editorial home; it must be assembled from register diffs (ORSR/FinStat), company team-page diffs, and founder LinkedIn posts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collection design cannot rely on a media feed for the cell's core topic; the register + team-page diffing tier is load-bearing, not supplementary.

negative_findings.description: Instarea returned no results in either the en or sk searches run in this pass; its current status, fintech relevance and any funding/hiring activity are unconfirmed. Similarly, no Slovak BNPL player (including any Nay-linked offering) was confirmed by name.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two seed actors named in the cell definition could not be substantiated from search in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The seed actor list may contain stale or mis-specified entries; carrying them forward unverified would pollute the watchlist.

negative_findings.description: TrustPay, a headline seed actor, appears to have rebranded to 'finby' and taken a Malta licence for EU expansion, per a SK commentary piece and the company's own press-release page.
negative_findings.result_summary: The seed actor name is stale; both names (and the SK and CZ legal entities) must be aliased in the glossary.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Name-based monitoring keyed only on 'TrustPay' would silently miss all post-rebrand announcements — precisely the period when a licence-driven org build-out occurs.

negative_findings.description: No SK-specific startup job board was confirmed. The query assumed 'startupjobs.sk' exists (the known regional board is the CZ-origin startupjobs.cz); results returned only Profesia and praca.sme.sk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Startup-specific job inventory for SK appears to sit on general boards and company career pages rather than a dedicated SK startup board.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hiring-signal collection must lean on general boards plus per-company career pages, which raises noise and per-actor crawl cost.

negative_findings.description: Several role titles this cell keys on have no settled Slovak form and circulate as English-in-local usage: 'Head of Compliance', 'Compliance Officer', 'CTO', 'MLRO'. The one live SK ad found blends both ('Staň sa naším hlavným Compliance Officerom').
negative_findings.result_summary: sk-language keyword sets must include untranslated English role titles inside Slovak sentences, plus 'zodpovedná osoba' as the AML-officer term of art.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A purely translated sk keyword list would miss most real postings; a purely English one would miss the Slovak sentence context that identifies the employer as SK-domiciled.

negative_findings.description: 'FINTECH SK' appears to be an actual company name (an MiCA-regulated SK fintech advertising a lead compliance officer role), which collides with the generic phrase 'fintech SK' used in most queries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query and dedupe logic must disambiguate the company name from the generic sector-plus-country phrase.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Unhandled, this collision either buries a real watchlist actor or floods the pipeline with generic sector articles.

negative_findings.description: No confirmation that major SK banks expose standard third-party ATS endpoints (Workday myworkdayjobs.com, SmartRecruiters jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<company>, SuccessFactors career sites) for Slovak entities.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in en surfaced only generic SmartRecruiters/Indeed landing pages; observed SK bank ATS are local (topjobs.sk, kariera.tatrabanka.sk, vub.sk, csob.jobs.cz/LMC).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Machine-readable ATS JSON endpoints would enable cheap structured collection; their apparent absence means collection must target HTML career pages and boards instead.

negative_findings.description: Praca.sk and Robota.sk were probed as SK job boards but did not surface as live, distinct portals in results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Queries returned Profesia, Kariera.sk (Zoznam), Worki.sk and the government portal instead; no evidence retrieved for praca.sk/robota.sk current status.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two seed-named boards may be defunct or merged (SK board market consolidated under Alma Career/Profesia); the collection plan should not assume they exist without verification.

negative_findings.description: No SK-language recruiting presence found for Worldline, Nexi, or card-scheme offices (Visa/Mastercard) in Slovakia during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: sk query mixing 'platobné', 'nábor' and vendor names returned only Global Payments (CZ/SK) and generic pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Payments-vendor hiring is a leading indicator of terminal/acquiring programmes; the absence of a SK-language channel means these must be tracked via English group ATS or CZ boards.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn jobs pages for SK banks are login-gated and ToS-restricted.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only public teaser pages appear in search; no automated collection attempted.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The richest source for leadership moves and senior hiring cannot be collected programmatically; budget for manual analyst review or licensed data.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched and confirmed reachable; all entries come from search-result evidence only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Liveness, HTTP status, and robots/ToS posture are unverified by design.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream deterministic verification must confirm status codes and anti-bot posture before any collection is scheduled.

negative_findings.description: Public web search cannot reliably retrieve individual LinkedIn *posts* by Slovak banking/payments professionals. Queries combining SK move phrases ('po rokoch opúšťam', 'nová výzva') with bank terms returned profile and company pages, never the underlying activity posts.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero SK-language personal announcement posts retrieved via search engine; only profile/company URLs surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's core premise — the individual announces before the employer — is real, but the post layer is effectively invisible to search-engine-based collection. Any production pipeline for this cell needs logged-in monitoring, LinkedIn's own APIs, or a licensed data product; a search-only pipeline will systematically miss the earliest signal.

negative_findings.description: No public, retrievable time series of LinkedIn employee-count for SK banks was found. Wikipedia and RocketReach give single-point headcounts (SLSP ~3,540 in 2023; Tatra banka ~3,500; 365.bank 616 in 2024) but no curve.
negative_findings.result_summary: Point-in-time headcounts only; no trend data source identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'headcount curve as org-change proxy' idea requires self-built snapshotting over time, or a paid product (LinkedIn Talent Insights, Live Data Technologies). Budget for it or drop the indicator.

negative_findings.description: Dedicated Slovak LinkedIn company pages for VÚB (Všeobecná úverová banka), UniCredit Bank CZ&SK, mBank SK, Privatbanka, Prima banka and Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka were not confirmed by URL in this run, although the institutions are clearly present and Wikipedia/thebanks.eu profiles were found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Institution confirmed, LinkedIn page URL not confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are major employers; leaving their pages unmapped is a real coverage hole in the professional-social channel. Should be resolved by direct LinkedIn company-name lookup rather than search engine.

negative_findings.description: No specific named Slovak banking/fintech recruiter or headhunter personal LinkedIn profile was identified in this run — only firm-level pages (Pedersen & Partners, Amrop, KPMG, KiTalent) and a listicle naming Pro HR and PERSONALITY.
negative_findings.result_summary: Firm level yes, person level no.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The recruiter-posts-first hypothesis needs named individual feeds to be actionable; firm pages post far less and far later.

negative_findings.description: Slovak query terms 'platby'/'platobné' and 'banka' collide heavily with LinkedIn's own help pages about paying for Premium via a bank, and with unrelated consumer content; 'nová výzva' is generic motivational language across all sectors.
negative_findings.result_summary: High false-positive rate on the most obvious SK query terms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design for this cell must anchor on institution names plus role nouns ('riaditeľ', 'člen predstavenstva', 'vedúci oddelenia platobných služieb') rather than on the move-phrase alone.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Stanton Chase office in Bratislava/Slovakia surfaced in either sk or en searches; nearest listed CEE offices are Prague, Vienna and Belgrade.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovak mandates appear to be served regionally; no SK-specific Stanton Chase publication channel identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids creating a phantom SK source; SK signals from Stanton Chase must be filtered out of regional/global content.

negative_findings.description: No standalone Hays Slovakia salary guide (hays.sk) was found; Slovak coverage appears folded into the Hays Czech Republic mzdový průzkum and CEE business-services teams.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only hays.cz salary-guide assets and a Hays Slovakia employer page on profesia.sk were located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: SK banking pay benchmarks from Hays must be sourced from a CZ-branded, registration-gated publication, with caution about country mix.

negative_findings.description: Searching in Slovak for explicit placement announcements ('obsadenie pozície', 'úspešne obsadená pozícia') by SK search firms returned no systematic announcement feed — SK executive search firms rarely publish named placements.
negative_findings.result_summary: Firms publish rankings, sector pages and thought leadership instead of named placements.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership-move detection in SK must lean on media, LinkedIn and company press rooms rather than search-firm announcements.

negative_findings.description: Searches did not surface an active Iventa Slovakia presence or SK-language content for Iventa within this cell's queries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Iventa appears mainly as an AT/CEE brand in results; no SK banking-relevant publication found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The seed actor list should be corrected rather than assumed live in SK.

negative_findings.description: Direct WebFetch of https://www.trend.sk/ and https://hnonline.sk/ both failed with a generic 'unable to fetch' from this agent's tooling; no HTTP status observed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Section maps, rubric URLs and RSS endpoints for the two most important Slovak business outlets could not be enumerated. Both are almost certainly live (they appear constantly in search results and third-party traffic profiles) — this is a tooling/bot-defence hypothesis, not evidence of a dead site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: TREND and HN are the cell's two anchor outlets; without their section/RSS structure the collector will fall back to search-engine discovery, which loses paywalled and older items.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovak for an explicit standing 'personalie' / 'ludia a kariery' column on trend.sk, hnonline.sk and forbes.sk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only Pravda's ekonomika section (ekonomika.pravda.sk/ludia/) and SITA's tag archive (sita.sk/tag/personalne-zmeny/) were confirmed as dedicated people/appointment channels. Whether TREND, HN and Forbes.sk still run a discrete named personnel rubric could not be confirmed from search results alone.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief assumes dedicated personnel columns across the domestic press; the evidence supports that only for a subset, so collection must lean on tag archives and keyword filters rather than named rubrics.

negative_findings.description: Looked for a free, complete TASR and SITA archive that could be crawled for dated appointment texts.
negative_findings.result_summary: TASR content is publicly visible only through its consumer portal teraz.sk, and SITA through sita.sk verticals/tags; the full wire products appear to be commercial subscriptions. No open bulk archive or public API was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Dated, quotable primary text is the main value of the wires; without a licensed feed the collector gets only what the portals choose to publish, with unknown coverage gaps.

negative_findings.description: Assessed access for SME/Index, Denník N / Denník E, HN and TREND.
negative_findings.result_summary: All four operate subscription paywalls on the majority of substantive articles; headlines, ledes and tag listings remain open.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The most detailed Slovak reporting on bank restructurings and contested exits is precisely the paywalled part. Budgeting for subscriptions is a prerequisite for anything beyond headline-level A5 monitoring.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed bulk/API access for the NBS supervised-entity register or the decisions register; the decisions listing appears to be a filtered HTML table.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a browser-network reconnaissance pass on subjekty.nbs.sk, registre.nbs.sk and the výroky filter to capture underlying JSON/XHR endpoints and pagination parameters before writing collectors.

coverage_gaps.description: ORSR and Obchodný vestník collection both require a watchlist of IČOs/ORSR IDs for every licensed SK bank, foreign-bank branch, payment institution and e-money institution. Only two example ORSR IDs were observed (VÚB, SZRB).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Materialise the watchlist by joining the NBS supervised-entity register and the EBA credit-institution/PSD2 registers, then resolve each to an ORSR ID and IČO once.

coverage_gaps.description: The NBS decisions filter exposes 'oblasť rozhodnutia' and 'druh rozhodnutia' facets whose allowed values were not enumerated in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the facet values and identify which correspond to prior-consent/personnel decisions so the collector can subscribe narrowly instead of ingesting all decisions.

coverage_gaps.description: Named individuals in regulatory decisions and commercial-register extracts are personal data; NBS/ORSR terms of use and any anonymisation practice were not reviewed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Review NBS and ORSR/justice.gov.sk terms of use and GDPR notices; define a retention and internal-use-only policy for person-level records before storage.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell covers appointments and governance changes but produces no signal on rank-and-file hiring volume, job postings or team build-out at SK banks and PSPs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure a sibling cell covers SK job boards (Profesia.sk, Kariera.sk, LinkedIn) and bank career pages; regulator sources cannot fill that dimension.

coverage_gaps.description: I did not establish the settled Slovak term set NBS uses for PSD2/EMI key function holders as opposed to banks' 'vedúci zamestnanec priamo podriadený štatutárnemu orgánu'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the controlled vocabulary from Opatrenie 6/2010 as amended and from the Zákon o platobných službách, and add it to the extraction glossary.

coverage_gaps.description: No concrete watchlist of SK bank / payment-institution / fintech IČOs was assembled in this pass; candidates are the plumbing, not the actor list.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run RPO API queries for SK NACE 64.19, 64.92, 64.99, 66.12, 66.19, 63.11 and intersect with the NBS supervised-entity and PSD2 registers to produce a durable IČO watchlist keyed for all register collectors.

coverage_gaps.description: Coverage of organizačná zložka / pobočka zahraničnej banky (branches of foreign banks and EU payment firms passporting into SK) is asserted but not demonstrated — no branch-specific register view was located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test ORSR entity pages for entities of type 'podnik zahraničnej osoby / organizačná zložka' and cross-check against the NBS passporting/branch lists and the home-state register via BRIS; document how branch establishment and closure surface in ORSR.

coverage_gaps.description: It is unclear how far back ORSR 'úplný výpis' exposes deleted officers, and RÚZ is documented as mandatory only from accounting period 2013 onwards.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe úplný výpis for two or three long-lived SK banks to establish the practical historical horizon for officer-level time series, and note the 2013 RÚZ floor in any longitudinal analysis.

coverage_gaps.description: The Obchodný vestník 'Konkurzy a reštrukturalizácie' section was seen in search results but not examined as a distinct sub-stream, and no separate SK insolvency register was assessed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess the Vestník insolvency section and any Register úpadcov equivalent as a dedicated stream for detecting distress-driven org change in SK fintech/payment vendors.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin by nature: orsr.sk, registeruz.sk, rpvs.gov.sk and Obchodný vestník are Slovak-only in substance, with only BRIS/e-Justice and vendor marketing pages in English.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Accept Slovak as the working language for this cell; budget for sk-language parsing (diacritics, -ová surname forms, legal-form abbreviations a.s. / s.r.o. / o.z.) rather than seeking English mirrors that do not exist.

coverage_gaps.description: Member-list deep URLs for SLASPO, SOPK, SAPIE innovator map, AFISP committees and AHK Slovakia were inferred from homepages/search snippets rather than fetched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Deterministic liveness pass should resolve each homepage to its actual členovia/orgány subpage before scheduling collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Conference and event speaker lists — explicitly the richest 'name + current title + employer' artefact for this cell — were not systematically enumerated (SBA events, AmCham/Britcham event portals, SAPIE and ITAS conferences, Fintech Matrix/ Slovak fintech events).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicated follow-on pass over association event/conference archives and Glue Up event portals (e.g. britchamsk.glueup.com) to harvest speaker rosters as a senior-management directory.

coverage_gaps.description: Trade-union side of the banking sector (odborové zväzy in banking, counterpart to SBA's employee-rights memorandum) was not scouted, and no regional-chamber (SOPK regional offices) officeholder lists were collected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout Odborový zväz / banking-sector unions and SOPK regional chambers for member companies, collective-bargaining announcements and named officials — direct jobs/headcount signals.

coverage_gaps.description: German-language (de) coverage for AHK Slovakia was only touched via one query; Hungarian-minority business associations in southern SK were not searched at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add de and hu query passes for bilateral chambers operating in Slovakia.

coverage_gaps.description: Members-only areas of chambers and associations (committee rosters, member directories behind login, Glue Up member portals) are the layer with the most named-officeholder detail but are not openly collectable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Flag for analyst/manual or membership-based access decision; do not attempt automated bypass.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed public SBA-run banking congress; the association's own event channel is unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl sbaonline.sk in full (SK + /en/) and the SBA LinkedIn feed manually for one annual cycle to determine whether a congress/annual conference exists and where it is announced; ask a SK-based analyst to confirm.

coverage_gaps.description: Event detail pages and programme PDFs (ZBK, IBV NBS, NBS) were not opened in this pass; only listing levels were confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a second-level crawler that follows each event listing to its detail page and any attached PDF, and run OCR/text extraction to harvest name + title + employer triples.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical speaker rosters (needed for the year-over-year title diff that makes this cell valuable) were not located; organiser sites typically overwrite the current edition.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull archived editions from the Wayback Machine for finweek.sk/speakers, finweek.sk/program, zbk.sk/podujatia and zlataminca.sk result pages back to ~2018 to build the baseline title series.

coverage_gaps.description: University career fairs (EUBA, STU, UK, TUKE) are unsourced — no exhibitor lists found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search faculty subdomains (nhf.euba.sk, fiit.stuba.sk, fhi.euba.sk) and Facebook/LinkedIn event pages directly in Slovak ('den kariery', 'kariernie dni', 'burza prace', 'partneri podujatia'); consider the universities' career-centre pages as the entry point.

coverage_gaps.description: CEE regional conferences that host Slovak speakers (Future Banking Summit Brasov, Czech/Hungarian/Polish banking and card conferences) were only touched at the edge.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a CEE sweep covering CZ (e.g. Bankovnictvi/Card Forum), PL, HU and RO conference speaker pages, filtering for Slovak-employer affiliations — SK executives often appear abroad before at home.

coverage_gaps.description: ATM/cash-cycle and self-service function holders in SK have no regional conference stage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Substitute vendor/CIT channels: ATMIA member directories, Diebold/NCR/Printec case studies and SK public-procurement ATM tender documents, which name responsible managers.

coverage_gaps.description: No source located in this pass for the governance/appointment record of the vláda SR session itself (rokovania.gov.sk) where SZRB/Eximbanka/Sociálna poisťovňa appointments are formally decided.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over rokovania.gov.sk and vlada.gov.sk materiály, searching 'vymenovanie', 'člen predstavenstva', 'generálny riaditeľ' plus the actor names; this is the primary-document layer beneath the news wires.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash-handling / CIT (cash-in-transit) and ATM-estate tenders by state-linked actors were not systematically explored; only card acquiring and payment gateways were.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run CPV-driven sweeps for 79710000 (security services), 30123600 (coin-handling), 'prepočet a spracovanie hotovosti', 'bankomat', 'CIT' across ÚVO and CRZ.

coverage_gaps.description: No Hungarian-language or Roma-community-facing public-sector channels were checked, and no English-language SK government payment-procurement mirror beyond TED was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm whether any in-scope authority publishes English notice summaries; otherwise record sk-only as the operating assumption for the domestic layer.

coverage_gaps.description: It is unclear which ÚVO datasets in the national open-data catalogue actually carry contact-person fields, versus requiring notice-level HTML parsing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve the catalogue distributions, sample one dataset, and document field coverage before committing to a bulk-data-only collection design.

coverage_gaps.description: Other state-adjacent financial actors were not explored: Slovenská konsolidačná, Slovak Investment Holding / SZRB Asset Management, VšZP (mass payment flows), and regional VÚC treasuries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the actor map from the MF SR org lists and run the same Vestník/CRZ/vacancy triad against each.

coverage_gaps.description: Accenture SK, IBM Slovensko, DXC Slovakia and Ness/other Kosice delivery centres have no confirmed reference or newsroom source in this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Directly fetch each vendor's SK country site (careers, newsroom, case studies) and their LinkedIn company pages; add ICO lookups on FinStat for headcount.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn — where most 'we welcome our new Slovakia FS lead' posts actually appear — was not collected, and is ToS-restricted for automated scraping.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide a compliant approach (licensed API, manual analyst review, or a permitted people-move newsletter) before relying on LinkedIn for A5 leadership moves.

coverage_gaps.description: SK-language IT trade press (itnews.sk, touchit.sk, nextech, PC Revue, Trend) was only reached indirectly via a vendor clipping page and not enumerated as sources in its own right.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sk-language pass over SK IT/business trade outlets for bank-project and vendor-appointment coverage, and register each outlet as a source.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was fetched for liveness; several are inferred index pages (e.g. KPMG media index, PwC aktualne-spravy index, FinReport /lidri/) derived from observed article URLs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Let the deterministic verification pass resolve index URLs; treat any 403/timeout as bot-defence rather than a dead source.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor case studies frequently anonymise the client bank, so programme-to-bank attribution is weak.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-reference anonymised case studies against contemporaneous job ads (Profesia) and bank annual reports to triangulate the client.

coverage_gaps.description: Case-level mass-redundancy notifications are not public; only aggregates.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: File a 211/2000 Z. z. infozákon request to Ústredie práce for anonymised employer-level records in NACE K (financial and insurance activities), and repeat quarterly.

coverage_gaps.description: The list of základné organizácie (in-bank union locals) of OZ PPaP and OZBP across all SK banks and payment firms was not enumerated; only Slovenská sporiteľňa locals were observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl ozppap.sk structure pages and cross-match union legal entities in the commercial register (RPO/ORSR) by name pattern 'Základná organizácia OZ PPaP, <bank>' to build the full counterparty map.

coverage_gaps.description: Individual regional labour offices (úrady práce, sociálnych vecí a rodiny) publish local notices and their own pages; none were individually assessed beyond one Trenčín-hosted procedural document.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the ~46 regional office subsites under upsvr.gov.sk/urady and test each for local hromadné prepúšťanie notices, prioritising Bratislava (bank HQ concentration) and Košice.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) is a central actor in the bargaining dispute but was reached only through third-party reporting, not through its own site in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess sbaonline.sk directly for statements, mandate/statutes and employment statistics; treat as the employer-side mirror of OZBP.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin and largely supranational (Eurofound, EU-OSHA); no SK-focused English union or labour-law feed was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Accept sk as the operating language for this cell; add UNI Europa Finance and ETUC/ETUI SK country pages as EN-language pointers in a follow-up pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Žilina, Banská Bystrica, Nitra and Prešov are effectively uncovered — no city-specific source for financial-sector delivery centres was identified beyond national portals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate and add the local news outlets and city/region investor pages for each city (e.g. municipal websites, regional SME/my* titles, bystricoviny-type local outlets) and the respective self-governing regions (ŽSK, BBSK, NSK, PSK); verify each individually.

coverage_gaps.description: A definitive list of banking/payments captives and BPO providers with regional Slovak sites has not been assembled; only DT IT Solutions and DT Services Europe were concretely tied to Košice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the AmCham BSCF member list and the SARIO/PwC SSC report tables, cross-reference against Finstat/ORSR company records for registered seats outside Bratislava, and build a per-employer, per-city actor map.

coverage_gaps.description: No company-registry or financial-statement source (ORSR, Finstat, registeruz) was evaluated in this pass, though these disclose employee counts and registered branch addresses by city.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Finstat and registeruz.sk as indirect sources for headcount and branch-location verification of named centres.

coverage_gaps.description: Leadership-move signal for regional centre heads (site directors, centre GMs) is only weakly covered — LinkedIn is the natural source but is ToS-blocked for automated collection.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Rely on BSCF conference speaker lists, cluster news and regional press appointment items; consider a licensed people-data provider if leadership tracking is a priority.

coverage_gaps.description: Several URLs were inferred from search-result metadata rather than fetched in this pass (e.g. SARIO news index, EKF TUKE root, KSK site root).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass and correct any moved paths; do not treat these as confirmed reachable.

coverage_gaps.description: Within the cell's named actor list, Oberbank Slovensko and mBank SK were resolved only to a site root / group press room; no SK-level management ('vedenie', 'o nás') page was confirmed for either.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl the navigation of oberbank.sk and mbank.sk directly to locate 'o nás'/'kontakt pre médiá' subpaths; if none exists, fall back to the Austrian and Polish group newsrooms plus the SK branch entry in orsr.sk.

coverage_gaps.description: Careers/ATS pages were confirmed only for SLSP and VÚB. The equivalent 'kariéra / voľné pracovné miesta' hubs for Tatra banka, ČSOB SK, 365.bank, Prima banka, UniCredit SK, mBank SK, Oberbank SK and J&T Banka were not individually resolved in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated per-actor pass on 'kariéra', 'voľné pracovné miesta', 'pridaj sa k nám', 'pracovné ponuky' and identify the ATS vendor behind each (many SK banks front onto third-party ATS hosts such as topjobs.sk, which offer far more structured listings than the bank page).

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom or sitemap.xml endpoints were identified for any of the newsrooms in this cell; every candidate is currently specified as an HTML crawl.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe /rss, /feed, /sitemap.xml and press-room platform feed conventions (especially for sk.media.mbank.pl, which runs on a purpose-built press-room product) to convert polling into cheap feed subscription.

coverage_gaps.description: Management-page diffing only detects change from the moment snapshotting begins; there is no historical baseline of who held which portfolio before the run started.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Backfill a baseline from the Wayback Machine for each 'vedenie/manažment banky' URL and from the last three years of annual-report governance chapters, so the first diffs are meaningful rather than noise.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell's actor list excludes second-tier SK banks that surfaced repeatedly during searching (Privatbanka, Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka / SZRB) and which do publish leadership changes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide explicitly whether non-systemic SK banks are in scope; if so, add szrb.sk/vedenie-banky and Privatbanka's press channel to the cell.

coverage_gaps.description: UniCredit's CZ&SK press centre was reached only through its /en/ path with Czech-derived URL segments (tiskove-centrum/tiskove-zpravy); the Slovak-language variant was not confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve the sk/cs language variants of the UniCredit press index and determine whether SK-branch-specific items are published only in the local-language edition.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank payment firms with foreign listed parents operating in Slovakia (acquirers, card schemes, PSPs, ATM operators) were not covered; the pass was bank-dominated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the actor map to payments parents with SK exposure (e.g. Worldline/Nexi-type acquirers, Global Payments-style JVs, Euronet's Slovak ATM/POS operations) and scout their English IR and 8-K/RNS-equivalent channels.

coverage_gaps.description: Group-level careers/HR channels of the parents were not scouted, only IR/press channels.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add parent-group careers portals and their Bratislava/Slovakia job feeds (Erste Group Careers, KBC/CSOB, RBI, Intesa) as a direct jobs signal complementing regulated disclosure.

coverage_gaps.description: The Belgian (FSMA/STORI) and Italian (CONSOB / eMarket SDIR-STORAGE) officially appointed mechanisms for KBC and Intesa were not identified, unlike Austria's OeKB IIC.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout and test the Belgian and Italian regulated-information storage mechanisms so all four main owners have an OAM-grade archival fallback.

coverage_gaps.description: The core premise — that parent English disclosure precedes Slovak subsidiary communication — is asserted but only anecdotally testable so far (the SLSP CEO case appears same-day on both erstegroup.com and slsp.sk).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a lead-time study over 10-20 paired events (parent release vs. subsidiary sk release vs. sk media) to set the real polling cadence and to decide whether this cell is a lead source or merely a redundant one per owner.

coverage_gaps.description: The Slovak supervisory side of appointments (NBS fit-and-proper approvals, which every appointment found is conditioned on) was out of this cell's scope and is unassigned here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure another cell covers NBS/ECB approval registers and the Slovak Commercial Register (ORSR) so announced appointments can be tied to their effective legal date.

coverage_gaps.description: The CSOB / 365.bank legal and operational merger is the dominant forthcoming SK org-change event and currently rests on a single channel (KBC newsroom/IR).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a dedicated multi-channel watch for this merger: KBC IR + Belgian OAM + CSOB SK and 365.bank sk newsrooms + Antimonopoly Office (PMU SR) decisions, so headcount and branch consolidation is caught from several independent sides.

coverage_gaps.description: SK-domiciled independent ATM deployers / ISOs beyond Euronet were not enumerated; the cell needs a full list of ATM operators registered or notified to NBS.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate NBS supervised-entity and PSD2 register categories for ATM/cash-services operators and build an IČO watchlist; cross-check with Obchodný vestník.

coverage_gaps.description: Košice and other regional SK delivery/shared-service locations of payments firms were not investigated; searching concentrated on Bratislava.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run sk-language searches on 'Košice centrum zdieľaných služieb platby / IT centrum' plus regional media (korzar.sme.sk, kosice.dnes24.sk) and regional ÚPSVaR offices.

coverage_gaps.description: SK general business media (Trend/eTrend, Hospodárske noviny, Forbes.sk, Index SME, Touchit) were not individually assessed as monitored feeds for payments people-moves.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess each for RSS availability, paywall depth and a 'ľudia a kariéry' / appointments column; add the viable ones as keyword-filtered feeds.

coverage_gaps.description: Scheme-side (Visa/Mastercard) CEE regional newsrooms and their CZ-language equivalents were not located; SK announcements likely originate there.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Identify Visa/Mastercard CEE press pages and CZ newsrooms and monitor them as the upstream channel for SK-relevant appointments.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was fetched and confirmed live; all liveness/status assessments are hypotheses from search-result metadata.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass; treat any 403/timeout as bot-defence rather than a dead source.

coverage_gaps.description: The SK glossary built here is thin on employment-event verbs used in appointment reporting (e.g. 'vymenovaný do funkcie', 'novým riaditeľom sa stal', 'posilnil vedenie', 'ukončil pôsobenie', 'presúva pracovné miesta').
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Expand the sk query set with these verb phrases combined with actor names, and add CZ-language variants given CZ/SK cluster reporting.

coverage_gaps.description: The Obchodný vestník URL was inferred rather than found in search results, and the ORSR search interface was not exercised. Both are central to the leadership-move tier.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Have the deterministic liveness pass resolve the current Obchodný vestník path, and separately probe ORSR for a stable per-ICO extract URL pattern and any rate limits.

coverage_gaps.description: The actor map is not yet enumerated. The PSD2 JSON register, the Slovak FinTech Association member list and the NBS crypto licensee set were all identified but not dereferenced into concrete company names in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated enumeration step: pull subjekty.nbs.sk/api/psd2, scrape slovakfintech.sk/clenovia/, and extract the six licensed SK CASPs, then union into a canonical watchlist keyed by ICO.

coverage_gaps.description: Founder-level channels other than LinkedIn were not probed: X/Twitter accounts of SK fintech founders, company Facebook pages (the Slovak FinTech Association maintains an active one), podcasts and YouTube interviews. Slovak business podcasts often carry the first mention of a senior hire.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a founder-channel discovery pass in sk covering X, Facebook company pages, and SK business podcasts/YouTube; assess each for lawful collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Talent-side intermediaries were not covered: SK fintech-focused recruiters and executive-search firms, and the sector salary surveys (Profesia publishes salary data) that reveal which roles are in demand.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search in sk for 'personálna agentúra fintech', 'executive search bankovníctvo Slovensko' and Platy.sk salary reports; recruiters' mandate announcements are an early, under-exploited hiring signal.

coverage_gaps.description: Cross-border registers were not searched. Several SK fintechs operate via CZ, MT or LT entities — finby's reported Malta licence is a live example — so appointments may be filed with the MFSA, the Czech ARES/justice.cz register or the CNB rather than with SK authorities.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the register tier to the CZ commercial register and, for confirmed multi-jurisdiction actors, the relevant host-state regulator registers and the EBA payment-institutions register.

coverage_gaps.description: The three highest-recall sources for this cell's core signal — LinkedIn, FinStat MONITORING and the funding databases — are all login-walled, paid or ToS-restricted. Only the free register tier is collectable without commercial arrangements.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Budget for a FinStat MONITORING subscription scoped to the watchlist ICOs (best value per signal), and define a manual-analyst workflow for LinkedIn rather than any automated approach.

coverage_gaps.description: Several SK banking/payments actors have no identified hiring channel yet: Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka, Poštová banka (post-365 rebrand entity), mBank/Fio/Oberbank/J&T Banka SK branches, and PSD2 licensed payment institutions / e-money institutions registered with NBS.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate NBS's register of banks, branches, payment institutions and e-money institutions, then map each entity to a careers URL and a Profesia employer C-ID.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-infrastructure vendors and processors operating in SK (ATM/POS estate, card personalisation, switch operators, e.g. Diebold Nixdorf, NCR/NCR Voyix, Printec, Monet+, Nexi, Worldline) are not yet mapped to hiring channels.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run sk+en queries per vendor name plus 'kariéra/voľné pozície/Bratislava' and register their ATS or Profesia employer pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Vacancy disappearance (a wind-down signal) and salary-band drift cannot be reconstructed retrospectively without a longitudinal archive.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Start weekly snapshotting immediately for the critical/high sources and store raw HTML plus parsed rows so appearance and removal dates are derivable; supplement with Wayback Machine captures of Profesia employer pages for backfill.

coverage_gaps.description: Executive/leadership moves are barely covered by job boards — such roles are filled via executive search, not public postings.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a complementary cell for SK executive-search firms and the NBS/Obchodný register filings on statutory-body changes; boards alone will under-detect leadership moves.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/API/structured feed identified for any SK board; robots.txt and ToS posture unchecked.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check robots.txt and any partner/API offering for Profesia (Alma Career) and the government portal; prefer licensed feeds over scraping for the two highest-volume sources.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn company pages unmapped for VÚB, UniCredit Bank CZ&SK, mBank SK, Privatbanka, Prima banka, SZRB, plus payments actors Worldline SK, Global Payments SK/Erste-JV entities and Mastercard/Visa SK country teams.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a direct LinkedIn company-name lookup pass (logged-in) for each named institution and record canonical /company/ slugs into the actor map.

coverage_gaps.description: The post/activity layer (the actual 'excited to announce' announcements) is not reachable by the tooling used here; only static profile and company pages are.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide between (a) licensed LinkedIn data (Talent Insights / Sales Navigator alerts), (b) an approved human-in-the-loop weekly manual sweep of a watchlist, or (c) accepting media corroboration (banky.sk, Forbes SK, Startitup) as the primary trigger with LinkedIn used only for confirmation.

coverage_gaps.description: No structured watchlist yet exists of SK banking/payments executives (CEOs, board members, heads of payments/cards/digital) and of the recruiters who place them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Seed a watchlist from confirmed names (Michaela Bauer/SLSP, Michal Liday/Tatra banka, Daniel Kollár/365.bank, Marco Iannaccone/UniCredit CZ&SK, Petr Řehák/Privatbanka, Dušan Tomašec/SZRB) and expand via banky.sk and SBA working-group listings.

coverage_gaps.description: No baseline headcount snapshot has been taken, so no trend can be computed for at least one collection cycle.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Take a dated headcount + title-cluster snapshot for every mapped company page at first run, then repeat monthly.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell is intrinsically personal-data heavy (named individuals, employment history) and LinkedIn's ToS prohibits automated collection.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define, before collection starts, a policy limiting stored fields to professional role facts (name, employer, title, date of change, source URL) and forbidding contact-data ingestion from aggregators such as RocketReach and Aeroleads.

coverage_gaps.description: Smaller SK-owned executive search boutiques (TARGET Executive Search, Personality Group, Perfect Personal, Jenewein/Talentor-type players) were only glimpsed via directories, not individually profiled.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl greenpages.sk and the Index SME ranking to enumerate them, then assess each firm's insights/news channel separately.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn — where SK recruiters actually post mandates, placements and market commentary — was not queried, and is the single richest intermediary channel for this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define a compliant LinkedIn monitoring approach (company pages of Amrop SK, Grafton SK, Hays, Manpower SK, plus named consultants) respecting ToS.

coverage_gaps.description: Employer-branding awards beyond Najzamestnávateľ (e.g. Via Bona, AmCham/BSCC employer recognitions, Great Place to Work SK) were not checked for banking participants.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sk-language sweep on 'zamestnávateľ roka', 'Great Place to Work Slovensko', 'employer branding ocenenie banka'.

coverage_gaps.description: The authoritative SK executive-search ranking (Index/SME) is behind a partial paywall, so firm-level placement volumes could not be extracted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Consider an SME/Index subscription or obtain the printed Kariéra Guide edition.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/sitemap endpoints confirmed for any outlet in this cell; every candidate's collection method is currently a hypothesis.
